# The Principle of Hope

*[Ernst Bloch](../philosophers/bloch.md) · 1954 · *Das Prinzip Hoffnung**

A three-volume summa (1954-1959), largely written in exile in the United States, in which [Bloch](../philosophers/bloch.md) makes hope and concrete utopia the driving force of human history, from daydreams to political projects. [Jonas](../philosophers/jonas.md) answers it in *[The Imperative of Responsibility](../works/imperative-of-responsibility-jonas.md)*.
